glossary.definition: (1) "Existing sources" means any treatment works that were built and operational under the terms of an NPDES permit prior to July 1, 1993, but does not include expansions or upgrades of existing treatment works authorized in rules adopted under section 6111.03 of the Revised Code after that date.
glossary.source_title: Section 6111.12 - Antidegradation policy applicable to surface waters of the state pursuant to applicable federal laws and regulations.

glossary.definition: (2) "Appropriate total maximum daily load procedures" means the procedures, policies, and guidelines used by the director prior to July 1, 1993, or subsequent revisions to those procedures established in rules adopted in accordance with Chapter 119. of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: appropriate total maximum daily load procedures
glossary.source_title: Section 6111.12 - Antidegradation policy applicable to surface waters of the state pursuant to applicable federal laws and regulations.
glossary.term: Appropriate total maximum daily load procedures

glossary.definition: (3) "Antidegradation review" means the consideration by the director of the technical, social, and economic need demonstration completed by any person requesting to lower water quality as provided in this section, including the public notice of the application and, at the discretion of the director, a public hearing on it.
glossary.source_title: Section 6111.12 - Antidegradation policy applicable to surface waters of the state pursuant to applicable federal laws and regulations.
